title: Property Caretaking
intro:
For Second-home and vacation-property owners in Northern California who are an hour or more away and have no trusted local person on the ground.

Your second home gets checked on schedule, problems get caught small, and you stop dreading what you'll find when you pull into the driveway.

title: Live-In Pet Care
intro:
For Northern California homeowners with pets who travel and have run out of people they actually trust.

Your pet stays home, on its routine, with one known person in the house — you leave without dread and come back to an animal that's fine.

title: Live-In House Sitting
intro:
For Northern California homeowners leaving for an extended stretch with a property worth watching.

You hand over the key to someone you know, leave, and come back to a house that ran without you.
